messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-11 02:05 UTC - spike in 5xx on /v1/generate (hosted-api-prod). Paging oncall.

sara: I'm on it. Redirecting to bridge in 2.

alex: joining. quick ask — do we know if it's client-side or model-side? initial graphs show latency + error rate together.

priya: I see a surge in tokenization errors in the logs, but also a downstream DB timeout. grabbing logs now.

mike: putting a temporary rate-limit at edge for the route to reduce pressure: `rlimit set /v1/generate 10r/s` (will revert when stable)

sara: good call, mike. can someone pull last 10m of runtime errors? `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --since=10m | grep ERROR` — paste results here.

alex: pasted; looks like kv-cache misses spiked and a few host OOMs on node-gpu-9. Possibly a rolling OOM cause. Also seeing a flurry of `failed to allocate buffer` entries.

priya: correlating with recent model rollout. Canary for model v2.1 was promoted ~01:58 UTC. Sidenote: rollout should have guarded mem limits.

sara: can we fallback traffic to v2.0? alex, can you flip traffic now (canary->stable fallback)?

alex: initiating rollback to model v2.0 on route /v1/generate. Command: `redwoodctl deploy rollback --route generate --target v2.0` — doing canary->0.

incident-bot: rollback started. Notifying infra to watch node memory.

mike: edge rate-limit looks effective — error rate dropped ~40% in last 2m. If rollback finishes cleanly we should see more.

priya: confirmed: mem usage returned to baseline on node-gpu-9 after rollback completed.

sara: nice. Good containment. Let's treat this as mitigated. Now post-incident: schedule a follow-up postmortem, assign action items, and update runbook entries that allowed this risky promotion.

alex: I can lead the postmortem write-up. Proposed 60m on Tue 03/16 15:00 UTC. Who else?

mike: I'll take the runbook edits around canary memory checks. Suggest adding an automated pre-promotion check for per-instance GPU memory headroom and kv-cache pressure.

priya: I'll own the regression tests for tokenization errors and ensure model packaging includes tokenizer sanity checks.

sara: owners noted. Action items with deadlines:
- alex: draft postmortem doc + timeline (due 2026-03-14)
- mike: add pre-promotion GPU headroom check to deployment pipeline (PR + test by 2026-03-20)
- priya: add tokenizer regression tests and add to CI (PR by 2026-03-19)
- sara: review and update on-call playbook to include rollback Qs and checklist (done draft by 2026-03-15)

alex: putting a skeleton postmortem doc here: https://redwood-internal/docs/postmortems/1829000000-generate-rollout.json — will populate timeline + impact numbers.

sara: also adding a short blameless customer-impact blurb for support: approx 07:58-08:06 PST saw 5.2% request failures for hosted customers on generate. Include guidance for support to credit/notify.

mike: runbook patch idea — add a single-line quick command for rollback and a link to `redwoodctl` usage. Example snippet to include:
```
# rollback canary to previous stable
redwoodctl deploy rollback --route generate --target v2.0 --wait
```

priya: and a checklist item: "Verify tokenizer pass on sample payloads (1000 random queries)" before promotion.

incident-bot: Created follow-up tasks in Tasks board: TASK-1192 (postmortem), TASK-1193 (runbook update), TASK-1194 (ci tests), TASK-1195 (support notif). Links: https://tasks.redwood/internal/board/ops

alex: scheduling: I'll create calendar invite for Tue 03/16 15:00 UTC + recording. If anyone can't make, please add notes to the draft doc.

sara: during handoff to next oncall, note that the immediate mitigation is complete. Add a line for next oncall: watch for memory churn and tokenization `ERR_TOKEN` spikes. If OOM trend resumes, escalate to infra lead.

mike: one more ops improvement: run `telemetry query` nightly to detect sudden increases in kv-cache miss rate; I'll add an alert threshold (kv-miss > 3x baseline in 10m).

priya: logging change: include model-version in tokenizer error lines so we can link errors to rollouts. I'll file a tiny logging PR.

sara: ok handing off. Next oncall: Alex will be primary until 08:00 UTC. Everyone keep eyes on Tasks. Thx team :thumbsup:

alex: acknowledged. I'll update the on-call notes channel with a short summary.

mike: thanks all. filing the runbook PR after lunch.

priya: cheers. I'll link tokenizer test results to the postmortem doc.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active mitigation. Postmortem meeting calendar invite created. Reopen thread if regressions occur.
